"""Drive the website in a real Chrome and check the things a unit test cannot.

    pip install playwright          # uses the Chrome already on the machine (no download)
    python scripts/browser_smoke.py --site https://aqar.pages.dev [--expect-listings 3]

Checks, in order:
  * the home and listing pages render with no JavaScript errors and no Content-Security-Policy violations
  * live listings load cross-origin from the API (CORS + API_BASE_URL are right)
  * markup hidden in listing data and in the URL is shown as text and never runs
  * the built-in sample inventory is not shown to visitors
  * the chat widget opens, sends a message and shows the assistant's reply
  * the microphone button is present (a real call still needs a human and a microphone)

Exit status 1 if any check fails. Nothing here sends WhatsApp messages or books anything.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from urllib.parse import quote

CHECKS: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []
SAMPLE_IDS = {"mivida-courtyard", "zayed-villa", "north-coast", "district-office"}  # the built-in sample listings


def check(name: str, passed: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    CHECKS.append((name, passed, detail))
    print(f"  [{'OK ' if passed else 'FAIL'}] {name}{': ' + detail if detail else ''}", flush=True)


def guarded(name: str, action) -> None:
    """Run one section; a timeout or missing element is a failed check, not a crash."""
    try:
        action()
    except Exception as error:  # playwright TimeoutError / Error
        check(name, False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:160]}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--site", required=True, help="website origin, e.g. https://aqar.pages.dev")
    parser.add_argument("--channel", default="chrome", help="installed browser channel (chrome | msedge)")
    parser.add_argument("--expect-listings", type=int, default=0, help="minimum live listings expected on the listing page")
    parser.add_argument("--expect-xss-listing", action="store_true", help="a hostile test listing (markup in its fields) is indexed")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-chat", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    site = args.site.rstrip("/")

    try:
        from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    except ImportError:
        sys.exit("playwright is not installed: pip install playwright")

    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(channel=args.channel, headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context(permissions=[], viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
        page = context.new_page()
        problems: list[str] = []
        page.on("pageerror", lambda error: problems.append(f"js error: {error}"))
        page.on("console", lambda m: problems.append(f"console {m.type}: {m.text}") if m.type == "error" else None)
        page.add_init_script("window.__pwned = 0;")

        def home() -> None:
            print(f"Home page: {site}/")
            page.goto(f"{site}/", wait_until="networkidle")
            check("home page renders", page.locator("main").count() > 0, page.title())
            check("no sample-inventory banner", page.locator(".dev-note").count() == 0)

        def listing() -> None:
            print("Listing page")
            page.goto(f"{site}/#/properties", wait_until="networkidle")
            page.wait_for_timeout(800)
            cards = page.locator(".card").count()
            check("live listings load from the API", cards >= args.expect_listings, f"{cards} card(s)")
            hrefs = page.eval_on_selector_all('a[href^="#/properties/"]', "els => els.map(e => e.getAttribute('href'))")
            linked = {href.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for href in hrefs}
            check("no invented sample listings are shown", not (linked & SAMPLE_IDS), f"sample ids linked: {sorted(linked & SAMPLE_IDS)}")
            body = page.inner_text("body")
            check("a missing price reads 'Price on request', never 'EGP 0'", "EGP 0" not in body and "EGPÂ 0" not in body)
            if args.expect_xss_listing:
                check("markup in listing data did not execute", page.evaluate("window.__pwned") == 0, f"__pwned={page.evaluate('window.__pwned')}")
                check("hostile listing is displayed as text", "Evil Villa" in body)

        def url_markup() -> None:
            print("URL-borne markup")
            page.goto(f"{site}/#/properties?location={quote('<img src=x onerror=window.__pwned=3>')}")
            page.reload(wait_until="networkidle")
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            check("markup in the URL did not execute", page.evaluate("window.__pwned") == 0, f"__pwned={page.evaluate('window.__pwned')}")
            check("URL value is shown as plain text", "<img src=x" in page.inner_text(".filters", timeout=5000))

        def chat() -> None:
            print("Chat")
            page.goto(f"{site}/", wait_until="networkidle")
            page.locator(".cb-launcher").click()
            page.wait_for_selector("#cb-panel:not([hidden])", timeout=10000)
            textarea = page.locator("#cb-panel textarea")
            textarea.fill("hello")
            textarea.press("Enter")
            # Free-tier hosts need up to a minute to wake: wait for the reply, not a fixed time.
            page.wait_for_function(
                "document.querySelectorAll('#cb-panel .cb-bubble').length >= 3 || document.querySelector('.cb-bubble--error')",
                timeout=90000,
            )
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            bubbles = page.locator("#cb-panel .cb-bubble").all_inner_texts()
            check("assistant replied", len(bubbles) >= 3 and page.locator(".cb-bubble--error").count() == 0, f"{len(bubbles)} bubbles")
            check("microphone button present", page.locator(".cb-voice-btn").count() > 0)
            stored = page.evaluate("JSON.stringify(sessionStorage) + JSON.stringify(localStorage)")
            check("no provider key reaches the browser", not any(marker in stored for marker in ("AIza", "gsk_", "EAA", "sk-")))

        guarded("home page", home)
        guarded("listing page", listing)
        guarded("URL-borne markup", url_markup)
        if not args.skip_chat:
            guarded("chat", chat)

        csp = [p for p in problems if "Content Security Policy" in p or "Content-Security-Policy" in p]
        check("no Content-Security-Policy violations", not csp, "; ".join(csp)[:1200])
        other = [p for p in problems if p not in csp and "favicon" not in p.lower()]
        check("no JavaScript errors on any page", not other, "; ".join(other)[:600])
        browser.close()

    failed = [name for name, passed, _ in CHECKS if not passed]
    print(f"\n{len(CHECKS) - len(failed)}/{len(CHECKS)} checks passed" + (f"; FAILED: {', '.join(failed)}" if failed else ""))
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

====================
FILE: D:\ZaWolf\Real_estate-main\scripts\build_frontend.py
====================
"""Build the static website for Cloudflare Pages (or Vercel).

    API_BASE_URL=https://aqar-api.onrender.com python scripts/build_frontend.py

The site is plain HTML/JS with no bundler, so "building" means: lay the files out
the way ``index.html`` expects (``/assets/...``), write ``runtime-config.js`` from
environment variables, and emit security headers. Output goes to ``dist/``.

Environment (all public values - this file's output is readable in the browser):

    API_BASE_URL            required, e.g. https://aqar-api.onrender.com (no path)
    CHAT_DEFAULT_LANG       ar | en            (default ar)
    VOICE_ENABLED           true | false       (default true)
    REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS      default 60000 (a free Render instance needs ~50 s to wake)
    SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY  true | false       (default false: never show sample listings)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "app" / "frontend"


class BuildError(ValueError):
    pass


def parse_bool(value: str | None, default: bool) -> bool:
    if value is None or not value.strip():
        return default
    lowered = value.strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
        return False
    raise BuildError(f"expected true or false, got {value!r}")


def normalize_api_base(value: str | None, *, allow_insecure: bool = False) -> str:
    """The API origin, without a trailing slash. HTTPS only (except local development)."""
    if not value or not value.strip():
        raise BuildError("API_BASE_URL is required, e.g. https://aqar-api.onrender.com")
    parsed = urlparse(value.strip())
    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname:
        raise BuildError(f"API_BASE_URL must be an absolute http(s) URL, got {value!r}")
    if parsed.path not in {"", "/"} or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
        raise BuildError("API_BASE_URL must be an origin only (no path, query or fragment)")
    if parsed.scheme == "http" and not (allow_insecure or parsed.hostname in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1"}):
        raise BuildError("API_BASE_URL must use https (microphone access and WebSockets need a secure origin)")
    return f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"


def build_config(env: dict[str, str], api_base: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    language = (env.get("CHAT_DEFAULT_LANG") or "ar").strip().lower()
    if language not in {"ar", "en"}:
        raise BuildError("CHAT_DEFAULT_LANG must be 'ar' or 'en'")
    try:
        timeout = int(env.get("REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS") or 60000)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise BuildError("REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS must be a number of milliseconds") from error
    return {
        "API_BASE_URL": api_base,
        "CHAT_DEFAULT_LANG": language,
        "REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS": max(timeout, 1000),
        "VOICE_ENABLED": parse_bool(env.get("VOICE_ENABLED"), True),
        "SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY": parse_bool(env.get("SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY"), False),
    }


def runtime_config_js(config: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    # json.dumps produces valid JS and escapes quotes, so no value can break out.
    body = json.dumps(config, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).replace("</", "<\\/")
    return (
        "// Generated by scripts/build_frontend.py - do not edit. Public values only.\n"
        f"window.APP_CONFIG = {body};\n"
    )


def content_security_policy(api_base: str) -> str:
    parsed = urlparse(api_base)
    websocket = ("wss" if parsed.scheme == "https" else "ws") + "://" + parsed.netloc
    return "; ".join(
        [
            "default-src 'self'",
            "script-src 'self'",
            # Templates set style="" attributes, which need 'unsafe-inline' for styles only.
            # styles.css @imports the brand fonts from Google Fonts (CSS here, files below).
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com",
            # Listing photos come from many https hosts.
            "img-src 'self' data: https:",
            f"connect-src 'self' {api_base} {websocket}",
            "font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com",
            "media-src 'self' blob:",
            "object-src 'none'",
            "base-uri 'none'",
            "form-action 'self'",
        ]
    )


def headers_file(csp: str) -> str:
    return f"""# Cloudflare Pages response headers (generated by scripts/build_frontend.py)
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), microphone=(self)
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
  Content-Security-Policy: {csp}; frame-ancestors 'none'

# The files are not content-hashed, so keep caching short and always revalidate config.
/assets/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=300, must-revalidate

/assets/runtime-config.js
  Cache-Control: no-cache

/
  Cache-Control: no-cache

/index.html
  Cache-Control: no-cache
"""


def inject_csp_meta(html: str, csp: str) -> str:
    """Also deliver the CSP as a <meta> tag, so hosts that ignore _headers are covered."""
    tag = f'<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="{csp}" />'
    if "</title>" in html:
        return html.replace("</title>", "</title>\n    " + tag, 1)
    return html.replace("<head>", "<head>\n    " + tag, 1)


def build(out: Path, env: dict[str, str], *, allow_insecure: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:
    api_base = normalize_api_base(env.get("API_BASE_URL"), allow_insecure=allow_insecure)
    config = build_config(env, api_base)
    csp = content_security_policy(api_base)

    # Empty the directory rather than deleting it: a dev server whose working
    # directory is dist/ would otherwise make the rebuild fail (Windows, notably).
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for child in out.iterdir():
        shutil.rmtree(child) if child.is_dir() else child.unlink()
    assets = out / "assets"
    # Everything under app/frontend is served as /assets/... by FastAPI; mirror that.
    shutil.copytree(SOURCE, assets, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "index.html"))
    (assets / "runtime-config.js").write_text(runtime_config_js(config), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "index.html").write_text(inject_csp_meta((SOURCE / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), csp), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "_headers").write_text(headers_file(csp), encoding="utf-8")
    return config


def sample_inventory_warning(config: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
    """Sample listings are invented. On a real (non-local) site they must be a deliberate choice."""
    host = urlparse(str(config["API_BASE_URL"])).hostname
    if config["SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY"] and host not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1"}:
        return (
            "SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY=true: this site will show INVENTED sample listings to visitors "
            "(labelled 'Development preview'). Delete the SHOW_PREVIEW_INVENTORY variable in the host's "
            "dashboard to show only the live catalogue."
        )
    return None


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--out", default=str(ROOT / "dist"), help="output directory (default: dist)")
    parser.add_argument("--allow-insecure-api", action="store_true", help="permit an http:// API origin (local testing only)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        config = build(Path(args.out), dict(os.environ), allow_insecure=args.allow_insecure_api)
    except BuildError as error:
        sys.exit(f"Frontend build failed: {error}")
    warning = sample_inventory_warning(config)
    if warning:
        print(f"WARNING: {warning}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Built {args.out}")
    for key, value in config.items():
        print(f"  {key} = {value}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Validate the deployment configuration. Never prints secret values.

    python scripts/check_env.py              # configuration only (used by start.sh)
    python scripts/check_env.py --connect    # also test every provider credential

Exit status 1 when APP_ENV=production and the configuration is unusable, so a

from app.observability.logging import redact  # noqa: E402


def _flag(value: object) -> str:
    return "set" if value else "MISSING"


def show_configuration() -> list[str]:

        ("QDRANT_API_KEY", _flag(settings.QDRANT_API_KEY)),

    for name, value in rows:
        print(f"  {name:28s} {value}")
    return settings.production_problems()


def run_connection_checks() -> bool:
    settings = get_settings()
    ok = True

    def report(name: str, passed: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        ok = ok and passed
        print(f"  [{'OK ' if passed else 'FAIL'}] {name}{': ' + detail if detail else ''}")

    print("Connection checks:")
    try:
        from app.database.migrations import schema_status
        from app.database.session import check_database, is_postgres

        connected, error = check_database()
        report("database", connected, error or ("postgresql" if is_postgres() else "sqlite"))
        if connected:
            up_to_date, detail = schema_status()
            report("migrations", up_to_date, detail)
    except Exception as error:
        report("database", False, redact(type(error).__name__))

    try:
        from app.database.vector_db import describe_collection

        vector = describe_collection()
        report("qdrant collection", vector["ok"], vector.get("error") or f"{vector.get('points', '?')} points, dim {vector.get('actual_dimension')}")
    except Exception as error:
        report("qdrant collection", False, type(error).__name__)

    if settings.EMBEDDING_BACKEND == "gemini" and settings.GEMINI_API_KEY:
        try:
            from app.rag.embeddings import EmbeddingModel

            vector = EmbeddingModel().embed_query("Ø´Ù‚Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„ØªØ¬Ù…Ø¹ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ø§Ù…Ø³")
            report("gemini embeddings", len(vector) == settings.EMBEDDING_DIMENSION, f"{len(vector)}-dimensional")
        except Exception as error:
            report("gemini embeddings", False, redact(str(error))[:120])

    if settings.GROQ_API_KEY:
        try:
            from groq import Groq

            models = [model.id for model in Groq(api_key=settings.GROQ_API_KEY).models.list().data]
            wanted = settings.GROQ_MODEL
            report("groq", wanted in models, f"{len(models)} models; {wanted} {'available' if wanted in models else 'NOT available'}")
        except Exception as error:
            report("groq", False, redact(str(error))[:120])

    if settings.whatsapp_configured:
        try:
            import httpx

            response = httpx.get(
                f"https://graph.facebook.com/{settings.WHATSAPP_API_VERSION}/{settings.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID}",
                params={"fields": "display_phone_number,verified_name"},
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN}"},
                timeout=15,
            )
            body = response.json() if response.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
            report("whatsapp token", response.status_code == 200, body.get("display_phone_number") or f"HTTP {response.status_code}")
        except Exception as error:
            report("whatsapp token", False, type(error).__name__)
    return ok


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--connect", action="store_true", help="also test each provider credential")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    settings = get_settings()
    problems = show_configuration()
    for warning in settings.production_warnings():
        print(f"  warning: {warning}")

    failed = False
    if problems:
        print(f"\n{len(problems)} configuration problem(s):")
        for problem in problems:
            print(f"  - {problem}")
        failed = settings.is_production
        if not settings.is_production:
            print("(not fatal: APP_ENV is not 'production')")
    if args.connect:
        print()
        failed = (not run_connection_checks()) or failed
    if failed:
        sys.exit(1)
    print("\nConfiguration OK" if not problems else "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Temporary diagnostic logging for WhatsApp vs Website RAG comparison.

Logs structured key-value pairs at each stage of the retrieval pipeline
so the two channels can be compared side by side.

No secrets, phone numbers, or personal data are logged.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
from typing import Any

logger = logging.getLogger("rag_diagnostic")


def _mask_id(value: str) -> str:
    """Return a short hash-safe identifier for logging."""
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]


def log_request_received(channel: str, session_id: str, query: str) -> None:
    """Log the incoming request."""
    logger.info(
        "DIAG request_received channel=%s session=%s query_len=%d",
        channel,
        _mask_id(session_id),
        len(query),
    )


def log_retrieval_stage(
    *,
    channel: str,
    session_id: str,
    query: str,
    requirements: dict[str, Any],
    collection_name: str,
    property_ids: list[str],
    document_ids: list[str],
    scores: list[float],
    filter_description: str,
    rerank_applied: bool,
    rerank_count: int,
    context_length: int,
    llm_model: str,
    history_length: int,
    status: str,
    error: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Log the complete retrieval pipeline result for one turn."""
    logger.info(
        "DIAG retrieval channel=%s session=%s collection=%s filters=%s "
        "doc_count=%d prop_ids=%s doc_ids=%s scores=%s rerank=%s rerank_n=%d "
        "context_len=%d llm=%s history_len=%d status=%s error=%s",
        channel,
        _mask_id(session_id),
        collection_name,
        filter_description,
        len(property_ids),
        property_ids,
        document_ids,
        scores,
        rerank_applied,
        rerank_count,
        context_length,
        llm_model,
        history_length,
        status,
        error or "",
    )

FILE: D:\ZaWolf\Real_estate-main\scripts\evaluate.py

"""Validate the evaluation dataset and report basic retrieval fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EVALUATION_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "evaluation"


def load_json(name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    path = EVALUATION_DIR / name
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as source:
        value = json.load(source)
    if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in value):
        raise ValueError(f"{path} must contain a JSON array of objects")
    return value


def validate_dataset() -> dict[str, int]:
    questions = load_json("questions.json")
    golden = load_json("golden_dataset.json")
    expected = load_json("expected_recommendations.json")
    question_ids = {item.get("id") for item in questions}

    for collection_name, collection in (("golden", golden), ("expected", expected)):
        unknown = {item.get("question_id") for item in collection} - question_ids
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"{collection_name} contains unknown question IDs: {sorted(unknown)}")

    return {"questions": len(questions), "golden": len(golden), "expected": len(expected)}


def main() -> int:
    counts = validate_dataset()
    print("Evaluation dataset valid: " + ", ".join(f"{key}={value}" for key, value in counts.items()))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Ingest files, embed their chunks, and index them in Qdrant.

Run this on a developer machine (it needs ``requirements-ingest.txt`` for the
PDF / spreadsheet / OCR parsers), pointing at Qdrant Cloud through the same
environment variables the API uses::

    pip install -r requirements-ingest.txt
    export QDRANT_URL=https://<cluster>.cloud.qdrant.io:6333 QDRANT_API_KEY=... GEMINI_API_KEY=...
    python scripts/ingest.py data/raw --recursive --rebuild

Queries and documents must be embedded with the same backend, model and
dimension, so use the same ``EMBEDDING_*`` settings here as on the server.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.database.vector_db import (  # noqa: E402
    create_client,
    ensure_collection,
    rebuild_collection,
    upsert_chunks,
)
from app.helpers.config import get_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.rag.embeddings import EmbeddingModel  # noqa: E402

try:
    from app.rag.ingestion.pipeline import ingest_directory, ingest_file
except ImportError as error:  # the lean API install has no document parsers
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Document parsers are not installed ({error.name}). Run: pip install -r requirements-ingest.txt"
    ) from error

logger = logging.getLogger("ingest")


def _chunks_from_result(result: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Collect valid chunk records from a file or directory result."""
    if "results" in result:
        return [
            chunk
            for file_result in result["results"]
            if file_result.get("status") == "success"
            for chunk in file_result.get("chunks", [])
        ]
    return list(result.get("chunks", []))


def index_path(
    path: str,
    *,
    collection_name: str | None = None,
    recursive: bool = False,
    rebuild: bool = False,
) -> int:
    """Run ingestion â†’ shared embeddings â†’ Qdrant upsert for a path."""
    source = Path(path)
    if source.is_dir():
        result = ingest_directory(path, recursive=recursive)
    else:
        result = ingest_file(path)

    chunks = _chunks_from_result(result)
    valid_chunks = [
        chunk
        for chunk in chunks
        if isinstance(chunk.get("text"), str) and chunk["text"].strip()
    ]
    if not valid_chunks:
        logger.info("No text chunks to index for %s", path)
        return 0

    # Embed only the records represented in this ordered list; embed_texts
    # preserves their order.
    embedder = EmbeddingModel()
    settings = get_settings()
    logger.info("Embedding %d chunks with %s:%s (%d dims)", len(valid_chunks), embedder.backend_name, embedder.model_name, embedder.dimension)
    vectors = embedder.embed_texts([chunk["text"] for chunk in valid_chunks])
    if len(vectors) != len(valid_chunks):
        raise RuntimeError("Embedding output count does not match chunk count")

    name = collection_name or settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION
    client = create_client()
    try:
        if rebuild:
            rebuild_collection(client, name)
        else:
            ensure_collection(client, name)
        return upsert_chunks(client, name, valid_chunks, vectors)
    finally:
        client.close()


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("path", help="A supported input file or directory")
    parser.add_argument("--collection", help="Qdrant collection name")
    parser.add_argument("--recursive", action="store_true", help="Scan directories recursively")
    parser.add_argument("--rebuild", action="store_true", help="Delete and recreate the collection")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s",
    )
    count = index_path(
        args.path,
        collection_name=args.collection,
        recursive=args.recursive,
        rebuild=args.rebuild,
    )
    print(f"Indexed {count} chunks into {args.collection or get_settings().QDRANT_COLLECTION}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

FILE: D:\ZaWolf\Real_estate-main\scripts\maintenance.py
====================
"""Housekeeping for the free-tier database. Safe to run any time; run it weekly.

    python scripts/maintenance.py                  # dry run: report what would be removed
    python scripts/maintenance.py --apply          # do it
    python scripts/maintenance.py --apply --conversation-days 60 --interaction-days 365

Neon's free plan has 0.5 GB of storage, so unbounded history eventually stops
the app. This removes, in order of how safe it is:

* expired replay-guard rows (webhook ids, spent voice tokens)
* conversation memory (LangGraph checkpoints) idle for ``--conversation-days``
* delivered staff alerts older than ``--alert-days``
* chat transcripts older than ``--interaction-days`` (leads, customers and
  bookings are kept: they are the business record)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select  # noqa: E402

from app.database import models as db  # noqa: E402
from app.database.session import is_postgres, session_scope  # noqa: E402


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="delete (default is a dry run)")
    parser.add_argument("--conversation-days", type=int, default=90)
    parser.add_argument("--alert-days", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--interaction-days", type=int, default=365)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    verb = "removed" if args.apply else "would remove"

    with session_scope() as session:
        expired = session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(db.ReplayGuard).where(db.ReplayGuard.expires_at < now))
        alerts = session.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(db.StaffNotification).where(
                db.StaffNotification.status.in_(("sent", "abandoned")),
                db.StaffNotification.created_at < now - timedelta(days=args.alert_days),
            )
        )
        interactions = session.scalar(
            select(func.count()).select_from(db.Interaction).where(db.Interaction.created_at < now - timedelta(days=args.interaction_days))
        )
        if args.apply:
            session.execute(delete(db.ReplayGuard).where(db.ReplayGuard.expires_at < now))
            session.execute(
                delete(db.StaffNotification).where(
                    db.StaffNotification.status.in_(("sent", "abandoned")),
                    db.StaffNotification.created_at < now - timedelta(days=args.alert_days),
                )
            )
            session.execute(delete(db.Interaction).where(db.Interaction.created_at < now - timedelta(days=args.interaction_days)))
    print(f"replay-guard rows: {verb} {expired}")
    print(f"delivered staff alerts older than {args.alert_days} days: {verb} {alerts}")
    print(f"chat transcripts older than {args.interaction_days} days: {verb} {interactions}")

    if is_postgres():
        from app.agents.checkpointer import close_checkpointer, purge_stale_threads, setup_checkpointer

        setup_checkpointer()
        if args.apply:
            print(f"conversations idle for {args.conversation_days}+ days: removed {purge_stale_threads(args.conversation_days)}")
        else:
            print(f"conversations idle for {args.conversation_days}+ days: (run with --apply to count and remove)")
        close_checkpointer()
    if not args.apply:
        print("\nDry run only. Re-run with --apply to delete.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Apply database migrations and create the LangGraph checkpoint tables.

    python scripts/migrate.py            # upgrade to the latest revision
    python scripts/migrate.py --check    # exit 1 if the database is behind (no changes)

Idempotent and safe to run on every start. A Neon database that has been idle is
suspended and takes a few seconds to wake, so connection failures are retried.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from alembic import command  # noqa: E402
from alembic.config import Config  # noqa: E402
from sqlalchemy.exc import OperationalError  # noqa: E402

from app.database.migrations import schema_status  # noqa: E402
from app.database.session import get_engine, is_postgres  # noqa: E402
from app.observability.logging import redact  # noqa: E402


# Errors no amount of waiting fixes: fail at once instead of retrying for a minute.
_PERMANENT = ("password authentication failed", "does not exist", "does not support ssl", "ssl required", "no pg_hba.conf entry")


def wait_for_database(attempts: int = 6) -> None:
    delay = 2.0
    for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
        try:
            with get_engine().connect():
                return
        except OperationalError as error:
            first_line = redact(str(error).splitlines()[0])
            if attempt == attempts or any(marker in first_line.lower() for marker in _PERMANENT):
                sys.exit(f"Database unreachable (attempt {attempt}/{attempts}): {first_line}")
            print(f"Database not ready (attempt {attempt}/{attempts}); retrying in {delay:.0f}s", flush=True)
            time.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(delay * 1.7, 15)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="only report whether the schema is up to date")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not is_postgres():
        sys.exit("DATABASE_URL (or POSTGRES_*) must point at PostgreSQL to run migrations.")
    wait_for_database()

    if args.check:
        up_to_date, detail = schema_status()
        print(detail)
        sys.exit(0 if up_to_date else 1)

    command.upgrade(Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini")), "head")
    _, detail = schema_status()
    print(f"Database schema {detail}", flush=True)

    from app.agents.checkpointer import close_checkpointer, setup_checkpointer

    setup_checkpointer()
    close_checkpointer()
    print("Conversation-memory tables ready", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: D:\ZaWolf\Real_estate-main\scripts\smoke_prod.py
====================
"""Post-deploy smoke test for the running API. Safe to run against production.

    python scripts/smoke_prod.py --api https://aqar-api.onrender.com --origin https://aqar.pages.dev

Optional environment (never printed): ADMIN_API_KEY (checks the staff API),
WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN (checks Meta's webhook handshake).

It reads data and sends one harmless chat message ("hello"). It never books,
never sends a WhatsApp message and never changes configuration. A free Render
instance may need ~50 seconds to wake, so the first request waits for it.
Exit status 1 if any check fails.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
import time

import httpx

RESULTS: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(name: str, passed: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    RESULTS.append((name, passed, detail))
    print(f"  [{'OK ' if passed else 'FAIL'}] {name}{': ' + detail if detail else ''}", flush=True)


def wake(client: httpx.Client, api: str) -> bool:
    """A sleeping free instance answers the first request slowly (or 502/503 while booting)."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
    attempt = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        attempt += 1
        try:
            if client.get(f"{api}/health", timeout=30).status_code == 200:
                return True
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            pass
        print(f"  ... waiting for the API to wake (attempt {attempt})", flush=True)
        time.sleep(5)
    return False


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--api", required=True, help="API origin, e.g. https://aqar-api.onrender.com")
    parser.add_argument("--origin", required=True, help="the website origin allowed by CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS")
    parser.add_argument("--expect-indexed", action="store_true", help="also require /health/ready to be fully ready (index populated)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    api = args.api.rstrip("/")
    admin_key = os.environ.get("ADMIN_API_KEY")
    verify_token = os.environ.get("WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN")

    with httpx.Client(follow_redirects=False) as client:
        print(f"API: {api}")
        awake = wake(client, api)
        check("API is up", awake)
        if not awake:
            return 1
        check("served over HTTPS", api.startswith("https://"), "WebSockets and the microphone need a secure origin")

        ready = client.get(f"{api}/health/ready", timeout=60)
        body = ready.json() if ready.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
        checks = body.get("checks", {})
        for name in ("database", "migrations", "conversation_memory", "vector_search", "providers"):
            if name in checks:
                detail = checks[name].get("error") or checks[name].get("detail") or ""
                severe = name != "vector_search" or args.expect_indexed
                check(f"readiness: {name}", checks[name].get("ok", False) or not severe, detail or ("ok" if checks[name].get("ok") else "not ready"))
        check("readiness overall", ready.status_code == 200 or not args.expect_indexed, f"HTTP {ready.status_code}")

        for path in ("/docs", "/openapi.json", "/redoc"):
            check(f"{path} is not exposed", client.get(f"{api}{path}", timeout=30).status_code == 404)
        check("/metrics requires credentials", client.get(f"{api}/metrics/", timeout=30).status_code in (401, 403, 503))

        headers = client.get(f"{api}/health", timeout=30).headers
        check("security headers present", headers.get("x-content-type-options") == "nosniff" and "strict-transport-security" in headers)

        preflight = client.options(f"{api}/chat", headers={"Origin": args.origin, "Access-Control-Request-Method": "POST",
                                                              "Access-Control-Request-Headers": "content-type"}, timeout=30)
        check("CORS allows the website origin", preflight.headers.get("access-control-allow-origin") == args.origin)
        evil = client.options(f"{api}/chat", headers={"Origin": "https://evil.example", "Access-Control-Request-Method": "POST"}, timeout=30)
        check("CORS refuses other origins", "access-control-allow-origin" not in evil.headers)

        chat = client.post(f"{api}/chat", json={"query": "hello", "language": "en"}, headers={"Origin": args.origin}, timeout=90)
        check("chat answers", chat.status_code == 200 and bool(chat.json().get("response")), f"HTTP {chat.status_code}")
        if chat.status_code == 200:
            session_id = chat.json()["session_id"]
            token = client.post(f"{api}/voice/token", json={"session_id": session_id, "language": "en"}, headers={"Origin": args.origin}, timeout=30)
            check("voice token issued (or voice cleanly disabled)", token.status_code in (200, 503), f"HTTP {token.status_code}")
            forged = session_id[:-1] + ("0" if session_id[-1] != "0" else "1")
            again = client.post(f"{api}/chat", json={"query": "hello", "session_id": forged}, timeout=60).json()
            check("a forged session id is not honoured", again.get("session_id") != forged)

        check("staff API rejects anonymous calls", client.get(f"{api}/admin/bookings", timeout=30).status_code in (401, 503))
        check("staff API rejects a wrong key", client.get(f"{api}/admin/bookings", headers={"X-Admin-Key": "definitely-wrong"}, timeout=30).status_code in (401, 503))
        if admin_key:
            good = client.get(f"{api}/admin/bookings", headers={"X-Admin-Key": admin_key}, timeout=30)
            check("staff API accepts the real key", good.status_code == 200, f"HTTP {good.status_code}")
            who = client.get(f"{api}/admin/diagnostics/client-ip", headers={"X-Admin-Key": admin_key}, timeout=30).json()
            check("rate limiter sees your real address (not the proxy's)", who.get("resolved") not in (None, who.get("peer")),
                  f"resolved={who.get('resolved')} peer={who.get('peer')} hops={who.get('trusted_proxy_hops')}")
        else:
            print("  (set ADMIN_API_KEY to also check the staff API and client-IP detection)")

        if verify_token:
            handshake = client.get(f"{api}/whatsapp/webhook", params={"hub.mode": "subscribe", "hub.verify_token": verify_token, "hub.challenge": "smoke-123"}, timeout=30)
            check("WhatsApp webhook handshake", handshake.status_code == 200 and handshake.text == "smoke-123", f"HTTP {handshake.status_code}")
        wrong = client.get(f"{api}/whatsapp/webhook", params={"hub.mode": "subscribe", "hub.verify_token": "wrong", "hub.challenge": "x"}, timeout=30)
        check("WhatsApp webhook refuses a wrong verify token", wrong.status_code == 403)
        unsigned = client.post(f"{api}/whatsapp/webhook", content=b"{}", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=30)
        check("WhatsApp webhook refuses unsigned events", unsigned.status_code == 401)

    failed = [name for name, passed, _ in RESULTS if not passed]
    print(f"\n{len(RESULTS) - len(failed)}/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed" + (f"; FAILED: {', '.join(failed)}" if failed else ""))
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from app.rag.retrieval.metadata_filter import build_metadata_filter  # noqa: E402
from app.rag.retrieval.reranker import rerank  # noqa: E402


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Real end-to-end RAG smoke test."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--query",
        required=True,
        help="Customer query text.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--requirements",
        default="{}",
        help='JSON object of structured requirements, e.g. \'{"location": "New Cairo"}\'.',
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--collection",
        default=None,
        help="Qdrant collection name.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--top-n",
        type=int,
        default=10,
        help="Hybrid candidates before rerank.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--top-k",
        type=int,
        default=3,
        help="Final results after rerank.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no-rerank",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip the cross-encoder.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no-generate",
        action="store_true",
        help="Stop after retrieval.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verbose",
        action="store_true",
        help="Enable INFO logging.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def _print_results(
    title: str,
    results: list[SearchResult],
) -> None:
    print(f"\n=== {title} ({len(results)}) ===")

    if not results:
        print("(none)")
        return

    for rank, result in enumerate(results, start=1):
        snippet = (result.text or "").replace("\n", " ")[:90]

        print(
            f"{rank}. property_id={result.property_id} | "
            f"chunk_id={result.chunk_id} | "
            f"source={result.source_file}\n"
            f"   semantic={result.semantic_score:.4f} | "
            f"lexical={result.lexical_score:.4f} | "
            f"combined={result.combined_score:.4f}\n"
            f"   text: {snippet}"
        )


def main() -> int:
    args = _parse_args()

    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s",
    )

    settings = get_settings()
    collection = args.collection or settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Preconditions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if not args.no_generate and not settings.GROQ_API_KEY:
        print(
            "FAIL: GROQ_API_KEY is not set in .env "
            "(or use --no-generate)."
        )
        return 1

    try:
        requirements = json.loads(args.requirements)

        if not isinstance(requirements, dict):
            raise ValueError("requirements must be a JSON object")

    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"FAIL: invalid --requirements: {exc}")
        return 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Qdrant connectivity
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    try:
        # Use the same Qdrant client factory as the ingestion pipeline.
        # This keeps Local Docker and Qdrant Cloud configuration consistent.
        client = create_client()

        existing = [
            item.name
            for item in client.get_collections().collections
        ]

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"FAIL: cannot reach Qdrant: {exc!r}")
        print(
            "Check that Qdrant is running and that QDRANT_URL is correct.\n"
            "For local Docker:\n"
            "  QDRANT_URL=http://localhost:6333"
        )
        return 1

    print(f"Qdrant reachable. Collections: {existing}")

    if collection not in existing:
        print(
            f"FAIL: collection '{collection}' does not exist on this "
            "Qdrant instance. Run scripts/ingest.py to create and "
            "populate it."
        )
        client.close()
        return 1

    points_count = (
        getattr(client.get_collection(collection), "points_count", 0)
        or 0
    )

    print(f"Collection '{collection}': {points_count} points")

    if points_count == 0:
        print("FAIL: collection is empty. Run scripts/ingest.py first.")
        client.close()
        return 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Retrieval
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    metadata_filter = build_metadata_filter(requirements)

    print(f"Query: {args.query}")
    print(f"Filter: {metadata_filter.describe()}")

    try:
        candidates = hybrid_search(
            query=args.query,
            requirements_filter=metadata_filter,
            collection_name=collection,
            qdrant_client=client,
            top_k=args.top_n,
        )

    except AttributeError as exc:
        print(
            f"FAIL: {exc!r}\n"
            "Your qdrant-client version may not have "
            "QdrantClient.search(). Check `pip show qdrant-client`; "
            "newer versions use query_points()."
        )
        client.close()
        return 1

    _print_results("Hybrid candidates", candidates)

    if not candidates and not metadata_filter.is_empty():
        # Diagnose: is the filter too strict, or do the payload keys
        # not match?
        unfiltered = hybrid_search(
            query=args.query,
            requirements_filter=None,
            collection_name=collection,
            qdrant_client=client,
            top_k=3,
        )

        print("\nFilter returned nothing. Unfiltered top results:")
        _print_results("Unfiltered (diagnostic)", unfiltered)

        if unfiltered:
            print(
                f"Payload keys seen: "
                f"{sorted(unfiltered[0].metadata.keys())}"
            )
            print(
                "If your filter fields (e.g. 'location', 'price') are "
                "missing from these keys, or nested under 'metadata', "
                "the Qdrant filter keys need adjusting."
            )

    if candidates:
        print(
            "Metadata keys on top candidate: "
            f"{sorted(candidates[0].metadata.keys())}"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Reranking
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    final_results = candidates

    if candidates and not args.no_rerank:
        final_results = rerank(
            args.query,
            candidates,
            top_k=args.top_k,
        )
        _print_results("Reranked", final_results)
    else:
        final_results = candidates[: args.top_k]

    if args.no_generate:
        client.close()
        return 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Generation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    generation = generate_response(
        customer_query=args.query,
        candidates=final_results,
        requirements=requirements,
    )

    print("\n=== Answer ===")
    print(generation.answer_text)

    print("\n=== Traceability ===")
    print(f"model:                  {generation.model}")
    print(
        f"grounding_property_ids: "
        f"{generation.grounding_property_ids}"
    )
    print(
        f"cited_property_ids:     "
        f"{generation.cited_property_ids}"
    )

    client.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Controlled comparison: Arabic query "ÙÙ„Ù„" (villas) through Website vs WhatsApp.
Runs the same query through both channels using the shared conversation_service,
with both fresh sessions and sessions with stale requirements.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.agents.service import conversation_service
from app.database.vector_db import create_client
from app.helpers.config import get_settings
from app.rag.retrieval.hybrid_search import embed_query, _to_qdrant_filter
from app.rag.retrieval.metadata_filter import build_metadata_filter
from app.agents.understanding import extract_requirements, classify_intent, normalize_text

QUERY = "ÙÙ„Ù„"


def extract_retrieval_info(result: dict) -> dict:
    props = result.get("properties", [])
    return {
        "property_ids": [str(p.get("property_id")) for p in props if p.get("property_id")],
        "cited_property_ids": result.get("cited_property_ids", []),
        "grounding_property_ids": result.get("grounding_property_ids", []),
        "response": result.get("response", ""),
        "intent": result.get("intent", ""),
        "agent": result.get("agent", ""),
        "error": result.get("error"),
        "requirements": result.get("requirements", {}),
        "language": result.get("language", ""),
    }


def run_channel_test(channel: str, thread_id: str, query: str) -> dict:
    result = conversation_service.run_turn(
        thread_id,
        query,
        channel=channel,
        customer_id=thread_id,
        modality="text",
    )
    return extract_retrieval_info(result.to_dict())


def direct_qdrant_search(requirements: dict) -> dict:
    settings = get_settings()
    filt = build_metadata_filter(requirements or {})
    qf = _to_qdrant_filter(filt)
    client = create_client()
    try:
        vec = embed_query(QUERY)
        search_kwargs = {
            "collection_name": settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION,
            "limit": 20,
            "query_vector": vec,
        }
        if qf is not None:
            search_kwargs["query_filter"] = qf
        points = client.search(**search_kwargs)
        prop_ids = []
        for p in points:
            payload = getattr(p, "payload", None) or {}
            pid = payload.get("property_id")
            if pid:
                prop_ids.append(str(pid))
        return {
            "raw_count": len(points),
            "property_ids": prop_ids,
            "filter": qf,
            "filter_describe": filt.describe() if filt else "(no filter)",
        }
    finally:
        client.close()


def main() -> int:
    settings = get_settings()
    print(f"Collection: {settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION}")
    print(f"Query: {QUERY!r}")
    print(f"Normalized: {normalize_text(QUERY)!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Controlled comparison test: Website vs WhatsApp RAG retrieval.
Runs the same normalized query through both channels using the shared
conversation_service.run_turn(), then compares retrieval results side by side.
No WhatsApp or website HTTP calls are made - both channels invoke the same
shared service entry point with different channel parameters and thread IDs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
import time
from typing import Any

sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.agents.service import conversation_service
from app.helpers.config import get_settings
from scripts.diagnostic_logger import log_retrieval_stage, log_request_received

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("channel_consistency")

QUERIES = [
    "Apartment for sale in New Cairo, 3 bedrooms, budget 20 million EGP",
    "Villa in Sheikh Zayed with garden",
    "Show me properties under 5 million EGP in 6th of October",
    "I need a 2 bedroom apartment in New Cairo",
    "What about the first property you showed me?",
]

WEBSITE_THREAD = "test:website:consistency_check"
WHATSAPP_THREAD = "test:whatsapp:consistency_check"


def extract_retrieval_info(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    props = result.get("properties", [])
    return {
        "property_ids": [str(p.get("property_id")) for p in props if p.get("property_id")],
        "document_ids": [str(p.get("chunk_id")) for p in props if p.get("chunk_id")],
        "scores": [float(p.get("score", 0.0)) for p in props],
        "cited_property_ids": result.get("cited_property_ids", []),
        "grounding_property_ids": result.get("grounding_property_ids", []),
        "response": result.get("response", ""),
        "intent": result.get("intent", ""),
        "agent": result.get("agent", ""),
        "error": result.get("error"),
        "language": result.get("language", ""),
    }


def run_channel_test(channel: str, thread_id: str, query: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    log_request_received(channel, thread_id, query)
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = conversation_service.run_turn(
        thread_id,
        query,
        channel=channel,
        customer_id=thread_id,
        modality="text",
    )
    info = extract_retrieval_info(result.to_dict())
    info["elapsed_ms"] = round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 2)
    info["channel"] = channel
    info["session_id"] = thread_id
    info["query"] = query
    log_retrieval_stage(
        channel=channel,
        session_id=thread_id,
        query=query,
        requirements=info.get("requirements", {}),
        collection_name=get_settings().QDRANT_COLLECTION,
        property_ids=info["property_ids"],
        document_ids=info["document_ids"],
        scores=info["scores"],
        filter_description="",
        rerank_applied=True,
        rerank_count=len(info["property_ids"]),
        context_length=len(info["response"]),
        llm_model=get_settings().GROQ_MODEL,
        history_length=0,
        status="degraded" if info["error"] else "ok",
        error=info["error"],
    )
    return info


def compare_results(website: dict[str, Any], whatsapp: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "query": website["query"],
        "same_property_ids": set(website["property_ids"]) == set(whatsapp["property_ids"]),
        "website_property_ids": website["property_ids"],
        "whatsapp_property_ids": whatsapp["property_ids"],
        "same_document_ids": set(website["document_ids"]) == set(whatsapp["document_ids"]),
        "same_cited_ids": set(website["cited_property_ids"]) == set(whatsapp["cited_property_ids"]),
        "website_cited": website["cited_property_ids"],
        "whatsapp_cited": whatsapp["cited_property_ids"],
        "same_grounding_ids": set(website["grounding_property_ids"]) == set(whatsapp["grounding_property_ids"]),
        "same_intent": website["intent"] == whatsapp["intent"],
        "website_intent": website["intent"],
        "whatsapp_intent": whatsapp["intent"],
        "same_agent": website["agent"] == whatsapp["agent"],
        "website_error": website["error"],
        "whatsapp_error": whatsapp["error"],
        "website_response_len": len(website["response"]),
        "whatsapp_response_len": len(whatsapp["response"]),
        "website_response_preview": website["response"][:200],
        "whatsapp_response_preview": whatsapp["response"][:200],
    }


def main() -> int:
    settings = get_settings()
    print(f"Collection: {settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION}")
    print(f"Embedding dimension: 768")
    print(f"LLM model: {settings.GROQ_MODEL}")
    print()

    all_comparisons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for idx, query in enumerate(QUERIES, 1):
        print(f"\n{'='*70}")
        print(f"TEST {idx}: {query}")
        print(f"{'='*70}")

        website_thread = f"{WEBSITE_THREAD}:{idx}"
        whatsapp_thread = f"{WHATSAPP_THREAD}:{idx}"

        website_result = run_channel_test("website", website_thread, query)
        whatsapp_result = run_channel_test("whatsapp", whatsapp_thread, query)

        comparison = compare_results(website_result, whatsapp_result)
        all_comparisons.append(comparison)

        print(f"\n  Website -> intent={website_result['intent']}, agent={website_result['agent']}")
        print(f"  WhatsApp -> intent={whatsapp_result['intent']}, agent={whatsapp_result['agent']}")
        print(f"  Website props: {website_result['property_ids']}")
        print(f"  WhatsApp props: {whatsapp_result['property_ids']}")
        print(f"  Same properties: {comparison['same_property_ids']}")
        print(f"  Website error: {website_result['error']}")
        print(f"  WhatsApp error: {whatsapp_result['error']}")
        print(f"  Website response ({len(website_result['response'])} chars): {website_result['response'][:150]}...")
        print(f"  WhatsApp response ({len(whatsapp_result['response'])} chars): {whatsapp_result['response'][:150]}...")

    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("SUMMARY")
    print(f"{'='*70}")
    all_same_props = all(c["same_property_ids"] for c in all_comparisons)
    all_same_cited = all(c["same_cited_ids"] for c in all_comparisons)
    all_same_intent = all(c["same_intent"] for c in all_comparisons)
    any_error = any(c["website_error"] or c["whatsapp_error"] for c in all_comparisons)

    print(f"All same property IDs: {all_same_props}")
    print(f"All same cited IDs: {all_same_cited}")
    print(f"All same intent: {all_same_intent}")
    print(f"Any errors: {any_error}")

    if all_same_props and all_same_cited and all_same_intent and not any_error:
        print("\nCONCLUSION: Both channels produce identical retrieval results.")
        return 0
    else:
        print("\nCONCLUSION: Differences detected between channels.")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Comprehensive channel consistency test including multi-turn conversation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.agents.service import conversation_service


def test_property_search():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("TEST 1: Property search with filters")
    print("=" * 60)
    query = "Apartment for sale in New Cairo, 3 bedrooms, budget 20 million EGP"
    result_w = conversation_service.run_turn(
        "test:web:1", query, channel="website",
        customer_id="test:web:1", modality="text",
    )
    result_wa = conversation_service.run_turn(
        "test:wa:1", query, channel="whatsapp",
        customer_id="test:wa:1", modality="text",
    )
    w_props = [p.get("property_id") for p in result_w.properties]
    wa_props = [p.get("property_id") for p in result_wa.properties]
    print(f"Website props: {w_props}")
    print(f"WhatsApp props: {wa_props}")
    print(f"Same: {w_props == wa_props}")
    print(f"Website error: {result_w.error}")
    print(f"WhatsApp error: {result_wa.error}")
    print(f"Website response: {result_w.response[:120]}...")
    print(f"WhatsApp response: {result_wa.response[:120]}...")
    return w_props == wa_props and result_w.error == result_wa.error


def test_conversation_history():
    print()
    print("=" * 60)
    print("TEST 2: Follow-up question (conversation history)")
    print("=" * 60)
    result_w = conversation_service.run_turn(
        "test:web:1", "What about the first property? Tell me more details.",
        channel="website", customer_id="test:web:1", modality="text",
    )
    result_wa = conversation_service.run_turn(
        "test:wa:1", "What about the first property? Tell me more details.",
        channel="whatsapp", customer_id="test:wa:1", modality="text",
    )
    w_props = [p.get("property_id") for p in result_w.properties]
    wa_props = [p.get("property_id") for p in result_wa.properties]
    print(f"Website intent: {result_w.intent}, agent: {result_w.agent}")
    print(f"WhatsApp intent: {result_wa.intent}, agent: {result_wa.agent}")
    print(f"Website props: {w_props}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Error handling and recovery test."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.agents.service import conversation_service

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("error_handling_test")


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("TEST: Error Handling and Recovery")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Simulate a Qdrant failure by patching the search
    thread = "test:error:user"

    # First, verify normal operation works
    print("\n--- Normal operation ---")
    result_normal = conversation_service.run_turn(
        thread,
        "apartment New Cairo",
        channel="whatsapp",
        customer_id=thread,
        modality="text",
    )
    print(f"Response: {result_normal.response[:100]}...")
    print(f"Error: {result_normal.error}")
    assert result_normal.error is None, "Normal operation should not have errors"
    print("PASS: Normal operation works")

    # Now simulate Qdrant failure
    print("\n--- Simulating Qdrant failure ---")
    from app.database.vector_db import create_client

    original_search = None

    def failing_search(self, **kwargs):
        from qdrant_client.http.exceptions import UnexpectedResponse
        raise UnexpectedResponse.for_response(
            type("Response", (), {"status_code": 500, "content": b"Internal Server Error"})()
        )

    # Patch QdrantClient.search to fail
    from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
    original_search_method = QdrantClient.search

    def mock_search(self, **kwargs):
        raise Exception("Simulated Qdrant connection failure")

    QdrantClient.search = mock_search

    try:
        result_error = conversation_service.run_turn(
            thread,
            "apartment New Cairo",
            channel="whatsapp",
            customer_id=thread,
            modality="text",
        )
        print(f"Response: {result_error.response[:100]}...")
        print(f"Error: {result_error.error}")
        # The workflow catches the exception and returns a fallback
        assert result_error.error is not None, "Error should be set when Qdrant fails"
        assert "search_unavailable" in result_error.response.lower() or "can't reach" in result_error.response.lower(), \
            "User should get a safe fallback message"
        print("PASS: Qdrant failure returns safe fallback message with error set")
    finally:
        QdrantClient.search = original_search_method

    # Recovery: Qdrant is available again
    print("\n--- Recovery after Qdrant restoration ---")
    result_recovered = conversation_service.run_turn(
        thread,
        "apartment New Cairo",
        channel="whatsapp",
        customer_id=thread,
        modality="text",
    )
    print(f"Response: {result_recovered.response[:100]}...")
    print(f"Error: {result_recovered.error}")
    assert result_recovered.error is None, "Recovery should clear errors"
    print("PASS: Recovery works - errors cleared after Qdrant restored")

    print("\nOverall error handling: PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Detailed stage-by-stage trace of "ÙÙ„Ù„" through Website and WhatsApp channels.
Tests both fresh sessions and sessions with stale accumulated requirements.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.agents.service import conversation_service
from app.database.vector_db import create_client
from app.helpers.config import get_settings
from app.rag.retrieval.hybrid_search import embed_query, _to_qdrant_filter
from app.rag.retrieval.metadata_filter import build_metadata_filter
from app.agents.understanding import extract_requirements, classify_intent
from app.agents.state import FILTER_KEYS

QUERY = "ÙÙ„Ù„"


def trace_stage(stage: str, channel: str, session: str, **kwargs):
    parts = " | ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in kwargs.items())
    print(f"  [{stage}] channel={channel} session={session[-8:]} | {parts}")


def run_traced_turn(channel: str, thread_id: str, query: str) -> dict:
    result = conversation_service.run_turn(
        thread_id,
        query,
        channel=channel,
        customer_id=thread_id,
        modality="text",
    )
    d = result.to_dict()
    props = d.get("properties", [])
    return {
        "intent": d.get("intent"),
        "agent": d.get("agent"),
        "error": d.get("error"),
        "requirements": d.get("requirements", {}),
        "property_ids": [str(p.get("property_id")) for p in props if p.get("property_id")],
        "cited_ids": d.get("cited_property_ids", []),
        "response": d.get("response", ""),
    }


def direct_qdrant_trace(requirements: dict) -> dict:
    settings = get_settings()
    filt = build_metadata_filter(requirements or {})
    qf = _to_qdrant_filter(filt)
    client = create_client()
    try:
        vec = embed_query(QUERY)
        search_kwargs = {
            "collection_name": settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION,
            "limit": 20,
            "query_vector": vec,
        }
        if qf is not None:
            search_kwargs["query_filter"] = qf
        points = client.search(**search_kwargs)
        raw_count = len(points)
        prop_ids_raw = []
        for p in points:
            payload = getattr(p, "payload", None) or {}
            pid = payload.get("property_id")
            if pid:
                prop_ids_raw.append(str(pid))
        from app.helpers.config import get_settings as gs
        after_demo = raw_count if gs().SHOW_DEMO_LISTINGS else raw_count
        from app.rag.retrieval.reranker import rerank
        from app.rag.retrieval.hybrid_search import SearchResult
        results = []
        for p in points:
            payload = getattr(p, "payload", None) or {}
            flattened = {}
            nested = payload.get("metadata")
            if isinstance(nested, dict):
                flattened = dict(nested)
            for key, value in payload.items():
                if key != "metadata":
                    flattened[key] = value
            results.append(SearchResult(
                property_id=str(payload.get("property_id", "")) if payload.get("property_id") else None,
                chunk_id=str(payload.get("chunk_id", "")) if payload.get("chunk_id") else None,
                text=str(payload.get("text", "")),
                metadata=flattened,
                combined_score=float(getattr(p, "score", 0.0) or 0.0),
            ))
        reranked = rerank(QUERY, results, top_k=5)
        rerank_ids = [str(r.property_id) for r in reranked if r.property_id]
        return {
            "raw_count": raw_count,
            "after_demo": after_demo,
            "after_rerank": len(reranked),
            "rerank_ids": rerank_ids,
            "filter_describe": filt.describe() if filt else "(no filter)",
            "filter": qf,
        }
    finally:
        client.close()


def main() -> int:
    settings = get_settings()
    print(f"Collection: {settings.QDRANT_COLLECTION}")
    print(f"Query: {QUERY!r}")
    print(f"Extracted requirements: {extract_requirements(QUERY)}")
    print(f"Classified intent: {classify_intent(QUERY)}")
    print(f"FILTER_KEYS: {FILTER_KEYS}")
    print()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("TEST 1: Fresh sessions (no prior conversation state)")
    print("=" * 70)

    print("\n--- Direct Qdrant search (property_type=Villa) ---")
    direct = direct_qdrant_trace({"property_type": "Villa"})
    trace_stage("qdrant_raw", "direct", "n/a", count=direct["raw_count"])
    trace_stage("qdrant_after_demo", "direct", "n/a", count=direct["after_demo"])
    trace_stage("rerank_output", "direct", "n/a", count=direct["after_rerank"], ids=direct["rerank_ids"][:5])

    print("\n--- Website: Fresh session ---")
    web = run_traced_turn("website", "trace:web:fresh", QUERY)
    trace_stage("intent_classify", "website", "fresh", intent=web["intent"], agent=web["agent"])
    trace_stage("requirements", "website", "fresh", req=web["requirements"])
    trace_stage("qdrant_results", "website", "fresh", count=len(web["property_ids"]), ids=web["property_ids"][:5])
    trace_stage("llm_generation", "website", "fresh", response_len=len(web["response"]), error=web["error"])

    print("\n--- WhatsApp: Fresh session ---")
    wa = run_traced_turn("whatsapp", "trace:wa:fresh", QUERY)
    trace_stage("intent_classify", "whatsapp", "fresh", intent=wa["intent"], agent=wa["agent"])
    trace_stage("requirements", "whatsapp", "fresh", req=wa["requirements"])
    trace_stage("qdrant_results", "whatsapp", "fresh", count=len(wa["property_ids"]), ids=wa["property_ids"][:5])
    trace_stage("llm_generation", "whatsapp", "fresh", response_len=len(wa["response"]), error=wa["error"])

    print("\n--- Fresh session comparison ---")
    print(f"  Same property IDs: {web['property_ids'] == wa['property_ids']}")
    print(f"  Same intent: {web['intent'] == wa['intent']}")
    print(f"  Same error: {web['error'] == wa['error']}")
    print(f"  Same requirements: {web['requirements'] == wa['requirements']}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TEST 2: Stale requirements (previous restrictive search persists)")
    print("=" * 70)

    restrictive_query = "apartment for sale in New Cairo, 2 bedrooms, budget 5 million EGP"

    print(f"\n--- Pre-search: {restrictive_query} ---")
    web_pre = run_traced_turn("website", "trace:web:stale", restrictive_query)
    wa_pre = run_traced_turn("whatsapp", "trace:wa:stale", restrictive_query)
    trace_stage("pre_requirements", "website", "stale", req=web_pre["requirements"])
    trace_stage("pre_requirements", "whatsapp", "stale", req=wa_pre["requirements"])
    trace_stage("pre_results", "website", "stale", count=len(web_pre["property_ids"]))
    trace_stage("pre_results", "whatsapp", "stale", count=len(wa_pre["property_ids"]))

    print("\n--- Direct Qdrant search with stale requirements ---")
    direct_stale = direct_qdrant_trace(web_pre["requirements"])
    trace_stage("qdrant_raw", "direct", "stale", count=direct_stale["raw_count"])
    trace_stage("qdrant_after_demo", "direct", "stale", count=direct_stale["after_demo"])
    trace_stage("rerank_output", "direct", "stale", count=direct_stale["after_rerank"], ids=direct_stale["rerank_ids"][:5])

    print(f"\n--- Follow-up: {QUERY} (on stale session) ---")
    web_stale = run_traced_turn("website", "trace:web:stale", QUERY)
    wa_stale = run_traced_turn("whatsapp", "trace:wa:stale", QUERY)
    trace_stage("followup_requirements", "website", "stale", req=web_stale["requirements"])
    trace_stage("followup_requirements", "whatsapp", "stale", req=wa_stale["requirements"])
    trace_stage("followup_results", "website", "stale", count=len(web_stale["property_ids"]), error=web_stale["error"])
    trace_stage("followup_results", "whatsapp", "stale", count=len(wa_stale["property_ids"]), error=wa_stale["error"])
    trace_stage("llm_generation", "website", "stale", response_len=len(web_stale["response"]))
    trace_stage("llm_generation", "whatsapp", "stale", response_len=len(wa_stale["response"]))

    print("\n--- Stale session comparison ---")
    print(f"  Same property IDs: {web_stale['property_ids'] == wa_stale['property_ids']}")
    print(f"  Same requirements: {web_stale['requirements'] == wa_stale['requirements']}")
    print(f"  Same error: {web_stale['error'] == wa_stale['error']}")
    print(f"  Website response: {web_stale['response'][:120]}...")
    print(f"  WhatsApp response: {wa_stale['response'][:120]}...")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TEST 3: Direct Qdrant filter comparison")
    print("=" * 70)

    print(f"\nFresh filter (Villa only):")
    print(f"  Filter: {direct['filter_describe']}")
    print(f"  Raw results: {direct['raw_count']}")
    print(f"  After rerank: {direct['after_rerank']}")

    print(f"\nStale filter (Villa + New Cairo + 2BR + sale + max 5M):")
    print(f"  Filter: {direct_stale['filter_describe']}")
    print(f"  Raw results: {direct_stale['raw_count']}")
    print(f"  After rerank: {direct_stale['after_rerank']}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("VERDICT")
    print("=" * 70)
    fresh_consistent = (
        web["property_ids"] == wa["property_ids"]
        and web["intent"] == wa["intent"]
        and web["error"] == wa["error"]
    )
    stale_consistent = (
        web_stale["property_ids"] == wa_stale["property_ids"]
        and web_stale["requirements"] == wa_stale["requirements"]
        and web_stale["error"] == wa_stale["error"]
    )

    print(f"  Fresh sessions consistent: {fresh_consistent}")
    print(f"  Stale sessions consistent: {stale_consistent}")
    print(f"  Direct Qdrant fresh results: {direct['raw_count']} raw â†’ {direct['after_rerank']} after rerank")
    print(f"  Direct Qdrant stale results: {direct_stale['raw_count']} raw â†’ {direct_stale['after_rerank']} after rerank")

    if fresh_consistent and stale_consistent:
        print("\n  CONCLUSION: Both channels are IDENTICAL. No code divergence.")
        print("  The production difference is due to SESSION STATE, not code.")
        print("  WhatsApp accumulates requirements across turns with no clear mechanism.")
    else:
        print("\n  CONCLUSION: CODE DIVERGENCE DETECTED between channels.")

    return 0 if (fresh_consistent and stale_consistent) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from app.rag.ocr.document_parser import DocumentParser
from app.rag.ocr.post_processor import OCRPostProcessor
from app.rag.normalization.property_normalizer import PropertyNormalizer
from app.rag.normalization.field_mapper import FieldMapper


def main() -> None:
    print("=" * 80)
    print("REAL ESTATE NORMALIZATION PIPELINE TEST")
    print("=" * 80)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Simulate OCR output
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    raw_ocr_text = """
    Ø´Ù‚Ø© Ù„Ù„Ø¨ÙŠØ¹ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„ØªØ¬Ù…Ø¹ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ø§Ù…Ø³
    Ù£ ØºØ±Ù Ù†ÙˆÙ…
    Ù¢ Ø­Ù…Ø§Ù…
    Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ø§Ø­Ø©: Ù¡Ù¥Ù  Ù…ØªØ± Ù…Ø±Ø¨Ø¹
    Ø§Ù„Ø³Ø¹Ø±: Ù£,Ù¥Ù Ù ,Ù Ù Ù  Ø¬Ù†ÙŠÙ‡ Ù…ØµØ±ÙŠ
    Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø·ÙˆØ±: Mountain View
    ØªØ´Ø·ÙŠØ¨ ÙƒØ§Ù…Ù„
    """

    print("\n[1] RAW OCR TEXT")
    print("-" * 80)
    print(raw_ocr_text)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Document Parser
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    parser = DocumentParser()

    parsed = parser.parse_text(raw_ocr_text)

    print("\n[2] DOCUMENT PARSER")
    print("-" * 80)
    print(f"Language hint: {parsed.language_hint}")
    print(f"Average confidence: {parsed.average_confidence}")
    print(f"Text:\n{parsed.text}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. OCR Post Processor
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    post_processor = OCRPostProcessor()

    processed = post_processor.process(parsed.text)

    print("\n[3] OCR POST PROCESSOR")
    print("-" * 80)
    print(f"Processed text:\n{processed.text}")
    print(f"Corrections: {processed.corrections}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Property Normalizer
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    normalizer = PropertyNormalizer()

    normalized_property = normalizer.normalize(processed.text)

    print("\n[4] PROPERTY NORMALIZER")
    print("-" * 80)
    print(normalized_property)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Field Mapper
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    mapper = FieldMapper()

    # Convert normalized property to dictionary
    property_dict = {
        "property_type": normalized_property.property_type,
        "transaction_type": normalized_property.transaction_type,
        "price": normalized_property.price,
        "currency": normalized_property.currency,
        "area": normalized_property.area,
        "area_unit": normalized_property.area_unit,
        "bedrooms": normalized_property.bedrooms,
        "bathrooms": normalized_property.bathrooms,
        "location": normalized_property.location,
        "compound": normalized_property.compound,
        "developer": normalized_property.developer,
        "finishing": normalized_property.finishing,
        "delivery": normalized_property.delivery,
        "amenities": normalized_property.amenities,
    }

    mapped = mapper.map_fields(property_dict)

    print("\n[5] FIELD MAPPER")
    print("-" * 80)
    print("Mapped fields:")
    for key, value in mapped.mapped.items():
        print(f"  {key}: {value}")

    print("\nUnmapped fields:")
    for key, value in mapped.unmapped.items():
        print(f"  {key}: {value}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Final Result
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("FINAL NORMALIZED PROPERTY")
    print("=" * 80)

    for key, value in property_dict.items():
        print(f"{key:20} = {value}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("TEST COMPLETED")
    print("=" * 80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
